correctness.rationale: The automorphism group is A5×C2 with 120 elements and exactly 63 nontrivial cyclic subgroups split as 15 rotation C2, 1 inversion C2, 15 reflection C2, 10 C3, 6 C5, 10 C6, 6 C10. For a subgroup H the fixed realization is PL equivalent to a flag orbit complex: retain vertex orbits with diameter<=r and connect two when all cross-distances<=r. At r>=5 the fixed complex is simplex; at r=0..4 exact graph-metric orbit comparisons produce the claimed seven homotopy-type rows. Nontrivial stages collapse to graphs or are join boundaries (S0)^{*4} and (S0)^{*6}, giving S3 and S5 integrally. Independent networkx automorphism construction and orbit-complex enumeration covered all 378 subgroup-scale cases, confirmed 101 critical face-vector entries and components. Interstage integral check for reflection H1 [2,4) independently solved integer cocycles and verified primitive map coefficient ±1, not just mod2; all other persistent intervals lie in isolated stages or follow components. Because the graph and all subgroups are exhausted, finite enumeration proves this finite-object classification.

evidence: Platonic-solid Rips homotopy provides all ordinary stages; published integral A5×C2 homology module describes ambient r=3 and a full automorphism group. They are broader in symmetry group or underlying topology but not in fixed-space persistence.

The published integral icosahedral lattice result treats ambient scale-three homology, explicitly excludes persistence at other scales, and its exact full RESULT was read.
